page.layout: Single scan of a front board: one blank leather binding with blind-tooled decoration (scalloped border, dotted rules, corner ornaments). No printed text, no printed page.
page.notes: Scan shows the outside cover of a bound volume, not a printed page. The board is worn and stained, with flaking at several spots. Blind-tooled decoration only: a scalloped frame with dotted lines, a central panel, and corner fleurons. No title, number, signature or running text is visible, so nothing is transcribed.
